exposure: changes in maternity services (e.g., partner attendance restrictions, cancelled antenatal classes, fewer physical midwifery consultations)
outcome: concerns about changes in maternity services
choice of place of birth (home birth, unassisted birth)
cohort: The study included 17,995 registered pregnant women in Denmark who responded to an online survey in April and May 2020.
finding: Danish pregnant women reported significant concerns about COVID-19 transmission to their unborn child and contracting the virus during hospital appointments in the early pandemic.
mod_finding: While overall home birth rates remained similar to pre-pandemic levels, restrictions in public home birth services led a small proportion of women to consider privately assisted or unassisted home births.
